Python's `material_fraction` answered 0 for that slab, whose side faces lie exactly in the slot's wall planes: on nist_ctc_01 the same slab inset 1.3e-4 mm across the width measures 1.0 in Python too (a boolean on coplanar faces). The record is a closed slot, not an open channel; its region lies within the native pocket's, so neither side refuses it. (captured/section_recesses/known_differences.json, the same record.)

Resolved by the intrinsic boss free-end rule: a unique open end, otherwise the axial boundary-area moment of the owning body, establishes the direction; a zero moment retains the boss with a presentation end gauge. The defining faces are the same (tests/invariance.rs compares only those). Needs a specification decision (an intrinsic choice of free end); Python behaves the same.
